method.latency: scheduled arrival to complete response, including sender lag; all outcomes retained
method.throughput: correct responses / (last completion - first scheduled arrival), not capacity
method.memory: sampled sum of controller and owned worker RSS; shared pages may count multiple times; excludes load generator. Direct mode retains idle controller.
method.scope: loopback demo model, offered load only; not maximum throughput, production SLO or zero-downtime proof
